履修条件
授業概要
1. Read the following book in a critical way.
Paris, Roland and Timothy Sisk eds.［2009］The Dilemmas of Statebuilding: Confronting the Contradictions of Postwar Peace Operations. Abington, New York: Routledge.
2. In more than 1500 words in English, describe problems caused by the changes of conflicts in the post-Cold War era as well as policies of the international society against these problems. In addition, pick up one particular example of these problems and describe your own opinion toward this issue from various points of view.
3. Reports should be mailed to D. Yamao (
daiyamao@scs.kyushu-u.ac.jp
) by June 30, 2020 if you need a credit.
